description: This file defines utility methods for managing account synchronization in an Android app, including creating sync accounts, scheduling periodic syncs, and triggering immediate syncs.

classes.name: SyncUtils
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods to manage sync accounts and schedule data synchronization.

methods.name: CreateSyncAccount
methods.description: Creates or reinitializes the sync account for the application if it doesn't exist, and sets up periodic sync and initial sync trigger.

methods.name: TriggerRefresh
methods.description: Triggers an immediate sync operation, bypassing normal scheduling, useful for manual refresh actions.
